TWO-WAY

QUICK ANSWERS

Before you
match.

Is CoGuava only for startup cofounders?+

No. It is designed for startup cofounders, franchise co-owners, local-business partners, and podcast co-hosts.

Can I find someone in my city?+

Yes. Location is central to matching—especially when you want to open or operate a physical business together.

Does CoGuava handle investments?+

Not in this prototype. CoGuava helps compatible people discover each other and start a conversation; it does not process investments or sell ownership interests.

Does a match guarantee success?+

No business relationship can be guaranteed. CoGuava helps make the right introductions and important information clearer, but you must complete your own legal, financial, and business diligence.

THE COGUAVA TRUST STANDARD

Trust is built
in layers.

No platform can promise that every person or business will be risk-free. CoGuava’s goal is to make deception harder, accountability stronger, and important information easier to check.

01

Verify identity

Confirm legal identity and display verification status clearly.

02

Show the evidence

Let members connect relevant experience, credentials, and business documents.

03

Keep money private

Financial information stays private and is verified only with informed consent.

04

Give people control

Mutual matching, reporting, blocking, and human review help protect the community.
